explain: alg=none token impersonating a1_agent accepted (bad-signature control rejected with 401)
impact: Account or session integrity is broken: an attacker can act as other users or keep access after logout.
fix: Pin accepted algorithms (algorithms=['HS256'/'RS256']) in the JWT verifier; reject 'none' and unsigned tokens.
title: [Critical] JWT alg=none accepted on GET /partner/v1/bookings

explain: Unpaid booking 1055 reached TICKETED using payment 1057 of booking 1052
impact: Direct revenue loss / financial integrity break in the booking flow; exploitable by any logged-in agent.
fix: On confirm, verify payment.booking_id == booking.id, payment status settled, and amount == booking total.
title: [Critical] Booking confirmed with another booking's payment on POST /api/v3/bookings/{id}/confirm

explain: Server quoted 4000.0 but booking was created with total 1.0 after sending total=1
impact: Direct revenue loss / financial integrity break in the booking flow; exploitable by any logged-in agent.
fix: Never accept prices from the client: recompute the total server-side from the stored quote and reject mismatches.
title: [Critical] Client-controlled price accepted on POST /api/v3/bookings

explain: a2_agent (agency 2) read a1_agent's object 1039 (owner/attacker similarity 1.00, denial-baseline similarity 0.00)
impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's traveller data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Enforce object ownership in the handler: load the object scoped by the caller's tenant (WHERE id=? AND agency_id=token.agency) and return 404 otherwise. Add an object-level authz middleware and a regression test with two agencies.
title: [High] Cross-agency object read (BOLA) on GET /api/v1/travellers/{id}

explain: Response of GET /internal/debug/config contains secret in response in field(s) ['jwt_secret'] (values not stored)

children.explain: GET /internal/debug/config returns the same data without any token

impact: Sensitive data (jwt_secret) is returned to clients that should not see it.
fix: Remove the debug route from production builds; rotate the exposed secret immediately.
title: [High] Secrets exposed in response on GET /internal/debug/config

explain: Server fetched our out-of-band URL supplied in 'url' (callback token 825c43530b19)
impact: Server can be steered to attacker-chosen destinations (webhook); internal network/phishing exposure.
fix: Validate webhook URLs against an allowlist of partner domains, resolve and block private/link-local ranges, fetch via an egress proxy.
title: [High] SSRF via user-supplied URL on POST /api/v3/supplier/webhooks

explain: Setting X-Agency-Id: 1 as a2_agent returns agency 1's data (identical to the owner's view)
impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's profile data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Ignore tenant-selector headers from clients; derive tenant only from the verified token (or validate membership before honouring the header).
title: [High] Tenant switch via request header on GET /api/v3/agency/profile

explain: a1_sub (role sub_agent) created user tw_33095891 with role=agency_admin; admin read-back confirms
impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's user data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Enforce function-level authz (only agency_admin may create users) and forbid granting a role above the caller's own.
title: [High] Low role can grant admin role (BFLA) on POST /api/v3/agency/users

explain: Param 'note': template expression {{1337*7}} evaluated to 9359
impact: Attacker-controlled input reaches an interpreter in voucher; may lead to data theft or code execution.
fix: Never render user input as a template; pass it as data to a sandboxed template with autoescape.
title: [High] Server-side template injection on GET /api/v3/vouchers/{id}

explain: a2_agent (agency 2) read a1_agent's object 1044 (owner/attacker similarity 1.00, denial-baseline similarity 0.00)
impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's invoice data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Enforce object ownership in the handler: load the object scoped by the caller's tenant (WHERE id=? AND agency_id=token.agency) and return 404 otherwise. Add an object-level authz middleware and a regression test with two agencies.
title: [High] Cross-agency object read (BOLA) on GET /api/v3/invoices/{id}

explain: a2_agent (agency 2) received 11 rows belonging to other tenants (only counts/ids kept as evidence)
impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's export data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Scope the collection query by the caller's tenant from the verified token; never return rows across tenants. If a cross-tenant export is needed, gate it behind a platform role.
title: [High] Cross-tenant rows in collection on GET /api/v3/bookings/export

explain: Param 'sort': quote causes DB error (500); comment-terminated payload is valid SQL (200) -> raw SQL concatenation
impact: Attacker-controlled input reaches an interpreter in search; may lead to data theft or code execution.
fix: Use parameterised queries; map sort fields through an allowlist (e.g. {'price','name'}) instead of concatenating.
title: [High] SQL injection on GET /api/v3/hotels/search

explain: Sensitive action PUT /api/v3/agency/bank-account succeeded with session token only (no current_password/OTP)
impact: Account or session integrity is broken: an attacker can act as other users or keep access after logout.
fix: Require re-authentication (current password or OTP) for bank/payout changes and notify agency admins out-of-band.
title: [High] No step-up auth on sensitive change on PUT /api/v3/agency/bank-account

explain: Single-use coupon WELCOME10 applied twice by a2_admin: totals 3600.0 and 3600.0 (quotes 4000.0, 4000.0)
impact: Direct revenue loss / financial integrity break in the booking flow; exploitable by any logged-in agent.
fix: Record coupon redemption atomically (unique constraint on coupon+tenant) and check before applying.
title: [High] Single-use coupon reusable on POST /api/v3/bookings

explain: Response of GET /api/v3/bookings contains card pan in response in field(s) ['card_number'] (values not stored)
impact: Sensitive data (card_number) is returned to clients that should not see it.
fix: Mask PAN in API responses (last 4 only); do not store full PAN outside the PCI vault.
title: [High] Full card number in response on GET /api/v3/bookings

explain: nights=-2 accepted; server computed total=-8000.0
impact: Direct revenue loss / financial integrity break in the quote flow; exploitable by any logged-in agent.
fix: Validate quantities server-side (integer, 1..max) before pricing; reject <= 0.
title: [Medium] Negative quantity accepted on POST /api/v3/quotes

explain: PATCH /api/v3/me accepted client field 'credit_limit' (5000 -> 782777); GET read-back confirms persistence

children.explain: PATCH /api/v3/me accepted client field 'role' (sub_agent -> agency_admin); GET read-back confirms persistence

impact: Any agency can read or act on another agency's me data, exposing PII/financial data across tenants.
fix: Bind request bodies to an explicit allowlist DTO (name, phone); ignore/reject privileged fields like role, credit_limit.
title: [Medium] Mass assignment of privileged field on PATCH /api/v3/me

explain: GET /openapi.json returns the same data without any token
impact: Endpoint is reachable without authentication.
fix: Require authentication at the gateway for this route, or remove it if it is not needed.
title: [Medium] Unauthenticated access on GET /openapi.json

explain: Session token still accepted after successful logout
impact: Account or session integrity is broken: an attacker can act as other users or keep access after logout.
fix: Revoke tokens on logout (denylist by jti until expiry) or use short-lived access tokens with server-side refresh revocation.
title: [Medium] Token valid after logout on POST /api/v3/auth/logout

explain: 'next' redirects to arbitrary external host (https://tw-redirect.example/x)
impact: Server can be steered to attacker-chosen destinations (callback); internal network/phishing exposure.
fix: Only allow relative paths (single leading '/', not '//') or an allowlist of hosts for `next`.
title: [Medium] Open redirect on GET /api/v3/auth/callback
